command: pre-registration of the main composition read

arms.fcomp@8: the code: base = the readable sibling, + 8 [v(sibling with the task's object) - v(sibling)], gated to the approach (gripper open)
arms.placebo@8: control: a random training-instruction pair at weight 8

metrics.episodes: 20 per arm and task, init states 30-49, SERVE_SEED 0, light recordings with every object's pose

hypotheses.H1: fcomp@8 > zeroshot: exact sign test p < 0.05 AND two-level bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference > +0.05
hypotheses.H1b: fcomp@8 > cfg@8 (exact sign test; Holm with H1c)
hypotheses.descriptive: per task success and binding accuracy (experiments/f1_binding.py); code bytes

metrics.pilot: zc_pilot: fcomp@8 14 of 70 vs cfg@4 4 and placebo@4 8 on practice states (go)
metrics.task_rule: every LIBERO-90 task pi0.5 fails zero-shot (< 0.6 in ledger/zeroshot90) whose factor_hooks.code_for has an object factor (a readable same-scene sibling with the same relation); 5 of them are among the 21 held-out tasks (48, 52, 53, 58, 62)
